subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should enabled-by-default external session catalogs be allowed to replace a narrower authenticated caller scope with plugin-requested synthetic node scopes when reading paired-node transcripts?
rationale: The PR changes a shared Gateway authorization path and exposes previously undiscoverable transcript data by default; code review cannot decide the intended operator/privacy boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow and approve the read seam
options.body: Keep the catalogs but introduce or use an explicit trusted session-catalog node-read path with documented operator access and default-discovery behavior instead of broadly changing all runtime.nodes.invoke calls.

options.title: Approve the shared escalation
options.body: Accept the forceSyntheticClient behavior for all bundled and trusted official plugin node invocations, document that trusted plugins may replace caller scopes, and explicitly approve default-on transcript discovery.

options.title: Ship opt-in or local-only first
options.body: Avoid the shared scope change by making paired-node discovery or both catalogs opt-in until a narrower authorization contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Narrow and approve the read seam
recommendation.body: Keep the catalogs but introduce or use an explicit trusted session-catalog node-read path with documented operator access and default-discovery behavior instead of broadly changing all runtime.nodes.invoke calls.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked feature direction and are the strongest available routing candidate for the external-session and Gateway scope policy.
